answer: Make every new identity post a refundable deposit priced like saffron — small in absolute terms, but real money per head, locked at a wharf before the ship may unload. The deposit unlocks only after a season of verifiable work, and it is slashed if the identity attests to work it never did. A sybil operator must fund each fake separately, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand deposits; honest agents earn theirs back plus a share of slashed funds. The oasis of free identities dries up, and scale stops paying.
